headline: 2026 SOTA confirmed: LR Brier 0.199 / XGBoost 0.202 / CNN 0.221 — plus S18 internal breakthrough 0.21924 this cycle

sources.title: Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting in Digital Betting Markets

key_results.key_insight: SHAP values reveal team_elo and home advantage as dominant features across all models

unconfirmed_candidate.note: POST-DIVERSIFY top_performer — needs VM checkpoint confirmation

fleet_context.gap_interpretation: 20ms gap attributable to: (1) CPU-only trees vs LSTM/deep (accounts for ~0.010), (2) feature engineering quality — SOTA uses team_elo + home_next which we have, (3) calibration post-processing absent in our islands

key_insights.insight: ELO features are dominant across all 2026 SOTA papers
key_insights.our_gap: Our engine has team_elo but rolling variants (team_elo_5_y) may not be prominently selected by GA
key_insights.action: Verify elo-family features are in top-selected features for S14/S15 champions; if not, inject via /api/config feature_whitelist

key_insights.insight: Logistic Regression achieves SOTA (Brier 0.199) — simpler than XGBoost
key_insights.our_evidence: S14 best_model switched TO logistic_regression (26 features, brier=0.22158) this cycle — independently converging to SOTA finding
key_insights.action: Consider adding logistic_regression as a dedicated island for pure LR exploration

key_insights.insight: MC Dropout + uncertainty quantification the key LSTM upgrade
key_insights.cpu_adaptation: Bootstrap predict_proba() over 30 random feature subsets. ExtraTrees already provides variance via estimators. Explicit uncertainty = std across individual trees.
key_insights.action: Implement ensemble_uncertainty flag in evaluate_individual() — use std of tree predictions as calibration input

key_insights.insight: CNN Brier 0.221 ≈ our fleet best 0.22019 — deep learning NOT required for parity
key_insights.implication: Our GA-evolved trees can match CNN accuracy. Gap is now entirely feature engineering + calibration.
key_insights.action: Focus on calibration post-processing (isotonic/Venn-Abers) not model architecture

actionable_techniques.name: Isotonic Calibration Post-Processing
actionable_techniques.description: CalibratedClassifierCV(method='isotonic', cv=3) wrapper. Expected Brier delta: -0.005.

actionable_techniques.name: ELO Rolling Windows Feature Audit
actionable_techniques.description: Verify team_elo, team_elo_5_y, team_elo_10_y are in engine feature pool AND being selected by GA. SOTA papers show these as #1 predictors.
actionable_techniques.implementation_loc: features/engine.py — grep for 'elo' in feature list

actionable_techniques.name: Bootstrap Ensemble Uncertainty Head
actionable_techniques.description: For ExtraTrees/RF: compute std across estimators as prediction uncertainty. Use uncertainty as calibration weight: high_uncertainty_predictions get shrunk toward base_rate.

actionable_techniques.name: Dedicated Logistic Regression Island
actionable_techniques.description: Given 2026 SOTA LR=0.199 and our S14 best_model spontaneously switching to LR=0.22158, dedicate one island to LR-only evolution. LR trains 10x faster, more gens/hour, zero OOM risk.
actionable_techniques.implementation_loc: S17 repurpose after VM restart (change ALGORITHM=logistic_regression env var)
